What these results include

Timing and portfolio accounting

Signals use the last observed SPY session of a W-FRI week. Execution is the next SPY session open. Three sleeves rotate weekly and normally hold each cohort for three weeks. Historical costs, membership removals, terminal settlements, and cash accounting follow the frozen engine.

Historical results cover January 30, 1995–December 31, 2025. The separate 2026 evaluation runs January 2–August 7. The 2026 period has already been used as evidence and is not a fresh holdout.

Backtest versus share estimates

Backtests use fractional allocation. This preview estimates whole shares by rounding to the nearest share. It stops short of a usable plan if targets exceed the budget or stock exposure differs by more than six percentage points. Residual cash and omitted expensive stocks can materially change live exposure.

Benchmark definitions

SPY is buy-and-hold, including modeled 5 bp entry cost. SPY/IEF 60/40 rebalances monthly with 5 bp per side. All comparisons use the same measurement sessions.

Pre-inception IEF is a synthetic Treasury proxy with 8.5-year maturity and 15 bp annual model expense; synthetic open equals close. Other ETF pre-inception proxies follow the frozen v1.1.0 authority. Missing quotes can be carried only for permitted valuation; they are never executable fills. The original report documents a one-session UUP valuation estimate on March 15, 2007.

Evidence limits

Historical market-cap dates do not prove original publication-time availability. Terminal-event, survivorship and point-in-time evidence remain subject to their preserved scope. The full operational implementation awaits independent audit.

Includes daily paths, annual returns, comparison metrics, and cost assumptions.

What has been checked

How the dashboard should be read

One signal, five allocation tiers

The tiers blend the stock-selection and ETF endpoints. Balanced targets 50% stocks and 50% ETFs in the current market state. The selected stock cohort usually holds for three weeks.

Model target versus account holdings

Targets are theoretical allocations. Whole-share rounding, execution prices, cash, and corporate actions change the holdings actually possible in an account.

Separate evidence windows

The main backtest covers 1995–2025. The separate 2026 simulation stops on August 7. Current October signals do not extend those historical performance tables.

Signal publication

The public dashboard reads the latest validated stock snapshot. Signals and historical backtests use separate measurement windows.
